visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a clean clinic room where a female patient lies flat on a treatment bed. She wears a grey medical cap and protective metal shields over her eyes, secured with white tape. A practitioner's hand is visible holding a white and green laser handheld device titled 'ClearSilk' over the patient's reddened cheek. (2) The practitioner moves the laser head slowly across the patient's skin. A small, bright red aiming laser point is visible on the skin's surface. Large yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom center. The patient remains still with no visible signs of discomfort. (3) Zooming in on the treatment area, the skin texture is highly detailed, showing patches of redness (rosacea). The laser status light on the device's head changes from green to a warmer yellow/orange as the treatment progresses. Text overlays periodically highlight key terms. (4) The camera pans to the other side of the face, repeating the treatment motion. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a medical studio. In the background, a person's hands holding a smartphone are briefly visible. (5) The final segment shows a minimalist white background with the clinic's logo 'DRX', contact numbers, and social media handles in a professional layout. There is a subtle 'brush stroke' texture on the background.
